# Ghosthub

> Native Mac management layer for local and remote tmux, Herdr, and Zellij sessions, with experimental support for Rex and Herdr Core. An alternative to juggling multiplexer sessions in a general-purpose terminal like iTerm2, Ghostty, or Kitty, with no local shell required and optional Git worktrees.

The Overview is a short visual tour, and the Docs below cover setup, daily use, and limits (including features that are still experimental). Every HTML page and `.md` file comes from the same source and tracks `main`. See the Unreleased section of the changelog for changes newer than the latest stable download.

## Docs

- [Documentation overview](https://ghosthub.ai/docs.md): How Ghosthub organizes hosts, sessions, projects, and worktrees
- [Getting started](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/getting-started.md): Requirements, installation, and opening your first session
- [Changelog](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/changelog.md): User-facing changes in each Ghosthub release
- [Sessions](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/sessions.md): Create, open, detach, rename, restore, and end sessions, including sessions started by agents
- [Launch profiles](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/launch-profiles.md): Save commands for new tmux sessions on macOS and Linux SSH hosts
- [Remote hosts](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/remote-hosts.md): SSH and exe.dev setup, host-key trust, logins, reconnects, and supported hosts
- [Projects and worktrees](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/projects-worktrees.md): Register repositories, create branch and pull-request worktrees, flag work, and inspect changed files
- [Windows and navigation](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/windows-navigation.md): Sidebar, Command Palette, windows, tabs, and window restoration
- [Terminal configuration](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/terminal-configuration.md): Fonts, colors, transparency, session previews, and remote clipboard settings
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Navigation, terminal Find, and tmux, Herdr, and Rex pane shortcuts
- [Privacy](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/privacy.md): Anonymous usage reporting, macOS permission prompts, and local state
- [Troubleshooting](https://ghosthub.ai/docs/troubleshooting.md): Common local, SSH, multiplexer, and worktree problems

## Other

- [Five-minute overview](https://ghosthub.ai/overview/): Visual product tour with screenshots
- [Source repository](https://github.com/kenn-io/ghosthub): Source code, releases, changelog, and issue tracker
- [kwt](https://kwt.sh): Git worktree manager used for optional project and worktree workflows
